name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
label: Quest
description: Wharfmaster Dizzywig is a courier errand delivering a crate of potions and reagents across the Barrens to the port town of Ratchet. The shipment is bound…
intro: Wharfmaster Dizzywig is a courier errand delivering a crate of potions and reagents across the Barrens to the port town of Ratchet. The shipment is bound across the Great Sea to the Old World aboard a vessel chartered through the local docks. It provides travelers a direct introduction to the bustling neutral commerce centered on Ratchet's pier.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have need to send a crate of potions, reagents and other items to my associates in the Old World. Little time I have to actually see them to the dock at Ratchet, and the last caravan has already left.
If you could, please take this to Wharfmaster Dizzywig. He will ensure that it is placed on the next boat to Blackwater Cove.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You seek passage on the next ship, or have some item you wish to send aboard it?

clips.title: Completion
paras: A small enough crate. Yes, I should be able to find room for this aboard the ship. It sails with the next tide, I trust this is soon enough? Excellent. Let me just enter it into my ledger.
All taken care of! Good day to you, adventurer.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
